OpenAI is launching ChatGPT for teens. The company describes this new initiative as "an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen their understanding, and use AI with confidence." ChatGPT for teens is activated when OpenAI's system estimates a user to be between the ages of 13 and 17, or when a user directly states their age.

OpenAI highlights four major features launching alongside ChatGPT for teens:

  • Study Mode, which uses guided questions and step-by-step support to help teens understand what they are learning.
  • A new responsible homework reminder feature that can identify situations where teens appear to be trying to take shortcuts on assignments, and direct them to Study Mode for a step-by-step collaborative problem-solving process.
  • Quizzes and learning visualization features that give teens more ways to practise, test what they know, and present difficult concepts more clearly to gauge their understanding.
  • In addition, the new Study Hours feature lets teens or parents preset times when Study Mode automatically activates, helping them more easily build good study habits into their regular routines.

In addition, ChatGPT for teens includes the following safety measures and safeguards:

For teen users, safeguards are part of the default experience. For users under 18, ChatGPT for teens employs age-appropriate protections designed to reduce exposure to content that may be harmful or inappropriate for their developmental stage, while preserving the ability to learn, create, and explore. […] This work also builds on the family tools we previously introduced alongside parental controls and notifications. Parents with linked teen accounts can set quiet hours, manage selected settings, and receive safety notifications in a limited set of high-risk situations. We are adding notifications related to eating disorders, while limiting the scope of information shared, focusing on the moments when offline support matters most.

OpenAI also explains in detail how ChatGPT operates for users under 18, including the following healthy-use measures:

  • Sensitive image upload reminders, alerting teens not to share private or sensitive images.
  • A teen-specific onboarding guide that introduces them to the available learning and safety features from the start.
  • Simple customisation options, such as colour themes and voice variations, that help make the experience feel more personal without blurring the line between a useful tool and a personal relationship.

You can learn more here about the latest ChatGPT for teens initiative.
